rows.en: If it's come to this, I'll show you my true power!!
So you made it. Perfect timing.
Kazari!!
Perfect timing...? What do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What's that supposed to mean!? Care to explain!?
Perfect timing...? The hell's that supposed to mean!?
Perfect timing...? What on earth do you mean!?
"Perfect timing," you say...? What are you scheming, you fiend!?
Perfect timing...? What on earth do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What on earth do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What do you mean!?
Perfect timing...? What do you mean!?
I'm just about to start an experiment. I think things are going to get interesting, don't you?
INTERESTING!!!
Gamel!
I've already given Gamel here seven of Mezool's Core Medals.
And now I'll feed him the Core Medals I've gathered, too...
What happens when you pour Core Medals into a single "vessel" called Gamel...?
I'm gonna try hard for Mezool!!
Kazari began feeding Gamel the Core Medals he was carrying!
Uwoooooooooh~~~~!!!
Looking good...
Kazari!! He alone won't be enough.
You'll be needing this, won't you?
...Mezool!
...They're there, aren't they... my Cores...
Mezool... where... did you go? I was looking for you...
Good boy... come here! I want all of you...!
Gh... Gwaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Damn that Mezool. She absorbed Gamel, Core Medals and all!
Haah... haah...
Now, Ikadevil.
5,000 Cell Medals, saved for this moment... Now, devour them to your heart's content!
Ugh... this is weird... Did I eat too much? I-it hurts~
What's that thing?
I had this one go around the Cube eating every Cell Medal it could pick up.
It's got a good 5,000 of them crammed in its belly.
...Cell Medals? Th-they weren't money!? I-I feel sick~
Sorry about that, Kanegon. Now, spit them all out!!
Ugh... *hack*... Koff-koff-koff-koffff~~~~~~!!
Ikadevil opened the container he'd had his underlings prepare.
At once, a huge mass of Cell Medals came gushing out and swirled through the air...
They surged at Mezool like a muddy torrent, fused with her and became a giant mass!!
The medals fused with her and became a giant mass!!
And then...
Graaaaaah...
...Magnificent!! This power! The power of desire!!
Impressive... It's beyond anything I imagined.
What's that...
What's that...
The heck is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
What is that...
Graaaaaaaaaaaah!!!
Whoa!!
Waah!!
Nwaaah!!
Gah!!
Whoa there...!!
Gwah...!!
What!?
Kh!
Not bad!
Tch!
Mezool can't control the power either. That thing's nothing but a medal monster.
Gwoooooooooooooh!!!
"Nothing but"...? That thing's way beyond that...!!
"Nothing but"...? That thing's way beyond that...!!
Hey, you! "Nothing but"...? That thing's way beyond that...!!
Th-that's incredible power!!

notes.note: Leader variants #0.3-#0.13 follow the second Pt_Chara_Check order in 0337.bla: OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero (confirmed by wording: #0.5 rough = Momotaros, #0.7 'kisama' = Rider 1, #0.79 'Tch' = Heero). Same order used for #0.56-#0.66 and #0.69-#0.79 and #0.82-#0.85. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Source has a typo (missing kana in 'what does it mean'); meaning is clear.
Subject 'I' restored: Kazari is the one running the experiment (he feeds the medals in #0.22).
Gamel's childlike speech kept simple rather than pidgin.
'Core' left number-ambiguous in source; plural 'Cores' since seven of her medals are in Gamel (#0.17).

#0.40-#0.46 and #0.50 are not referenced by MessWinSet in 0337.bla (script jumps #0.39 -> #0.47 -> #0.51): an unused/alternate Kanegon version of the Cell Medal scene. Speakers inferred: #0.40/#0.44/#0.46 Kanegon, #0.42/#0.43/#0.45 Ikadevil, #0.41 unknown (Ankh or Kazari) so kept speaker-neutral. Kanegon referred to as 'it' per glossary g=n.
Kanegon coughing up the medals; cough rendered as words, no earlier English for this sound.
Giant Greeed (Berserk) roars #0.53/#0.68/#0.81: no earlier English found; rendered Graaaah / Graaaah!!! / Gwooooh!!!.
00 (Setsuna) variant: the source is a grudging 'not bad' acknowledging the enemy's strength.
Echoes Ankh's 'nothing but a medal monster' (#0.80). #0.84 is Momotaros snapping at Ankh ('Hey, you!').
Dummy Dopant after both disguises dropped (end of 0336).

report: 80/80 rows. Leader variants mapped via 0337.bla Pt_Chara_Check order (OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero). #0.40-#0.46/#0.50 are an unused Kanegon alt scene (speakers inferred; #0.41 speaker unknown, kept neutral). New sounds: Giant Greeed roars, Kanegon coughing. No names outside the glossary.
